title: GTA 6's Swamp Hides Something Deadlier Than Gators 🐊 #Shorts
description:
Grassrivers is GTA 6's wetland region, Leonida's take on the Florida Everglades. Rockstar calls it "the untamable jewel of Leonida's crown" and warns there are "far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves."

Source: rockstargames.com/VI (Grassrivers page, official screenshots) + official GTA VI Trailers 1 and 2.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
